p165584985.desc:
Featuring an expansive layout with refined natural finishes and sea views extending out from every room, this four-bedroom penthouse at Le Reve in Dubai Marina is an ideal option for a long-term rental.

Accessed via private elevator, the residence welcomes you into a vast double living area framed on three sides by large windows. The dining room and kitchen are conveniently located in their own separate sections without being fully closed off to create a seamless entertaining area. The kitchen, fitted with integrated appliances, also contains an informal breakfast nook.

All four bedrooms are master suites with warm wood flooring, lavish en-suites and expansive walk-in closets. A private office/lounge and a TV room offer further options for relaxed entertaining. Staff quarters, comprising a maid’s and driver’s room, are tucked discreetly away and can be accessed through a service entrance.

Residents also enjoy a wide array of the development’s leisure facilities spanning the private elevator, 24/7 concierge and valet, a spa, salon, TechnoGym fitness center, service entrance, and a relaxing infinity pool.

Dubai Marina offers convenient access to The Walk at JBR, Dubai Marina Mall, and Bluewaters Island. Thanks to direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Golf Club rest 15 minutes away, while Mall of the Emirates, Burj Al Arab, and Downtown Dubai can be reached within 20 to 25 minutes.

Contact us to schedule an exclusive appointment today.
